newsitem.title: USA: Credit Store names Riordan president.
newsitem.headline: Credit Store names Riordan president.

text.p: Credit Store Inc said Tuesday that Kevin Riordan became president and chief operating officer on April 1.
The position of chief operating officer is newly created. Riordan assumes the title of president from Martin J. Burke, who remains chief executive officer.
Riordan was president and chief operating officer of Long Beach Acceptance Corp from 1995 to 1997.
The Credit Store, operating through its wholly-owned Service One International Corp subsidiary, markets, underwrites and administers credit cards issued to sub-prime debtors.
